issues.title: Broken Cross-References to External Modules
issues.why: The overview and AC-19 reference files in ../12-cicd-pipeline-workflows/ and ../13-generic-cli/ which are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Treat external module links as harness-scope artifacts per AC-21 and assume they resolve in the full repository structure.

issues.title: Ambiguous Concurrency Implementation
issues.why: Section 02-release-pipeline.md references a 'canonical concurrency contract' in spec/13 but does not provide the logic for SQLite WAL or locking locally.
issues.fix: Implement CI-level concurrency using the provided YAML snippet and defer local CLI locking to the spec/13 implementation.

issues.title: Inconsistent Placeholder Syntax
issues.why: The spec uses two families of placeholders (Legacy vs Modern) across different files (03 vs 08), which could lead to partial substitution if the wrong sed command is used.
issues.fix: Use the consolidated regex and substitution logic provided in 09-placeholder-tokens.md to catch both families.
